details:
Because i used a translator, there may be some awkwardness.

In a conversation-centric game like VRChat, the avatar element - the reflection of yourself - is crucial. 

VRChat is built on Unity, and the possibilities are endless when it comes to creating and using different avatars. 

Some people make their own avatars in the process, while others pay to have them customized. 

However, some evil-minded people have been stealing avatars from public worlds in VRChat and secondarily distributing them to make money illegally, or even creating worlds with stolen avatars and making them available to many people. New users may not realize that the avatars are illegal, and some people may use them despite the fact that they are illegal.

Currently, there is a report feature within VRChat. 

On the avatar tab, it says that if you report a stolen avatar, you will be subject to legal proceedings, but as a general user, it is difficult to take that risk and report it. 

So, I would like to simplify or lighten the reporting process to make it easier for general users to report.

Alternatively, I would like VRChat to take action and punish organizations that illegally copy avatars or worlds. 

VRChat developers are busy and have a lot of great features to add and suggestions from other users, but the issue of piracy has been around for a long time and hasn't been addressed at all, so I hope they can help protect creators and improve VRChat.
title: Requests to simplify reporting
